tools.name: check_link_in_bio
tools.description: Check link-in-bio pages for broken links. Give up to 10 page addresses from any provider (Linktree, Beacons, Later, Kapshur or any web page). Kapshur fetches each page once, finds its links (up to 50 for each page) and checks each one (HEAD, then GET). The JSON report lists, for each page: dead link
